metadata.case_name: CHE CHE v. LEUNG SIU TONG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: self employed blacksmith making small knives by hand
plaintiff.occupation_after: self employed blacksmith making small knives by hand

injuries.description: He suffered an intertrochanteric fracture of the right femur.
source: He suffered an intertrochanteric fracture of the right femur.

injuries.description: the Plaintiff's right knee was also injured in the accident and that on admission to hospital it was swollen to about twice its normal size; pain from the right knee which is still experiencing a degree of crepitus with the possible development of osteoarthritis.
source: the Plaintiff's right knee was also injured in the accident and that on admission to hospital it was swollen to about twice its normal size.

the Plaintiff's continuing limp and difficulty in standing for long periods are due not to the fracture of the femur but to pain from the right knee which is still experiencing a degree of crepitus with the possible development of osteoarthritis.

manifestations.description: the Plaintiff's continuing limp and difficulty in standing for long periods
still experiencing a degree of crepitus with the possible development of osteoarthritis
right knee ... on admission to hospital it was swollen to about twice its normal size

treatments_received: insertion of a nail attached to a bone plate secured to the shaft by four bone screws
admitted to hospital for eight weeks
use of crutches for a period of one month

losses.description: continuing limp and difficulty in standing for long periods
reduction in output from 40-50 a day to 24-25 pieces a day and a 20% reduction in earning capacity
